name: PT Golden Eagle Energy Tbk
summary: PT Golden Eagle Energy Tbk engages in the coal mining business in Indonesia. The company owns interests in a coal concession that covers an area of 3,238 hectares located in East Kalimantan; and 2,143 hectares located in South Sumatera. It is also involved in general surveying, exploration, exploitation, processing, refining, and trading activities. In addition, the company offers mining support services. The company was formerly known as PT Eatertainment International Tbk and changed its name to PT Golden Eagle Energy Tbk in August 2012.
